what: Scrolls a photo row sideways inside a vertically scrolling panel (modal·section). The panel’s inner height is set to the photo row width to create vertical scroll length, and on every scroll the panel’s scrollLeft moves to the current scrollTop over .5s power1.out, so the row flows left slightly behind the scroll. Below 1024px it is not applied and the photos stack vertically.

options.[data-fx-part=inner]: Inside the panel — height set by row width
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Row flowing sideways (left text + photos) — sticky while attached

from.where: works.html Work photo panel (original .modal-gallery__wrap — --content-height = .modal-gallery__content.offsetWidth, on each scroll gsap.to(wrap, { scrollLeft: scrollTop }), 1024px and up only, overflow auto .8s after opening)

note: The panel itself must be a scroll container (overflow auto, fixed height). Inside smooth scrolling such as lenis, add data-lenis-prevent to the panel. The original blocks page scrolling for .8s while the panel opens — that is the job of the modal on the consuming side.
